verdict.rationale: Heap's documented APIs cover data ingestion and identity management: track, bulk track, identify, user and account properties, and user deletion. Nothing in the evidence shows an API or MCP server that creates dashboards or reports, so an agent cannot build a dashboard end-to-end. Sense Chat is an in-product AI assistant for getting to insights, which is an adjacent feature rather than programmatic dashboard construction.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent build a dashboard of my key metrics end-to-end via the API or MCP server
